bookingFlow.talkText: Call or message us directly. We genuinely enjoy speaking with travelers.

faqs.question: How far in advance should I book?
faqs.answer: We recommend booking at least 1–2 weeks in advance, especially during peak season (December–February and July–August). For large groups or custom itineraries, 3–4 weeks ahead is ideal to ensure everything is perfectly arranged.

faqs.question: What payment methods do you accept?
faqs.answer: We accept bank transfers and Mobile Money (MTN, Telecel Cash, AirtelTigo), and card payments through Taptap Send. A non-refundable payment of $400 per person secures any trip and comes off your total, with the balance due 30 days before you travel. Day tours are paid in full when you book.

faqs.question: Do you accommodate solo travelers?
faqs.answer: Absolutely. Many of our most memorable tours have been with solo travelers. You'll receive the same quality of experience with a dedicated guide. We can also connect solo travelers with compatible small groups to reduce costs if preferred.

faqs.question: Do you offer airport pickup?
faqs.answer: Yes, we offer airport pickup and drop-off as an add-on service. Our driver will meet you at Kotoka International Airport with your name on a sign and transfer you to your hotel. Please provide your flight details when booking.

faqs.question: Can I book a tour for tomorrow?
faqs.answer: Subject to availability, yes! WhatsApp us directly at +233 50 367 3473 for last-minute requests. We'll do our best to accommodate you, though we cannot guarantee availability on very short notice during busy periods.

bookingFlow.heroSubtitle: Whether this will be your first time in Ghana or a long-awaited return, tell us a little about the journey you're imagining. Our team here in Accra will take it from there with you.
